text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Flutter, flutter~!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's like a butterfly! Like a flower! Red 
and pink, so pretty~!
choice_data_list: That kimono looks really good on you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! I didn't know much about design 
and stuff, so I just said, "I want 
something cute!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And then, this super cute outfit arrived, 
and I was totally surprised!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer! I want to go out just like 
this!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the shrine, the shrine! I 
wonder if the food stalls are still open~?

While not as crowded as on New Year's Day, 
there were still a few food stalls around, 
and the area was fairly busy.

text_block_list.name: Male Shrine Visitor
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look at that! That girl's kimono is 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Bundled-Up Woman
text_block_list.text:
Really! So cute~! The colors are so vivid, 
just like a flower.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ! Thanks! Listen, so this is, right?

text_block_list.name: Boy Holding Mother's Hand
text_block_list.text:
"Mommy! That big sister's outfit is so 
pretty!"

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"That's called a kimono. The bottom part 
is called a hakama... wait, is that a 
skirt? I wonder how it's made—it's quite 
an intricate kimono~."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah. Hey, hey!

Perhaps due to the crowd, people keep 
getting swept away before Haru Urara can 
say what she wants to say.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ah... And there they go. What a bummer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go pray! I want the gods to 
see this outfit too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, gods! This is my new outfit. Isn't 
it super cute?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I'm gonna do my very, very best in this 
outfit, so please keep watching over me!"

Once we finished our prayers and caught 
our breath, I asked Haru Urara what she 
had started to say to the people around us 
earlier.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
! You know how everyone was praising it? 
So I wanted to let you know that this 
outfit is super, super amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
The "craftsmen" painted these flowers one 
by one, too! Even though some of them are 
so tiny!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And the people who snipped and stitched, 
and the hair accessories, and the tassels 
on the cords—

Though clumsy with her words, Haru Urara's 
feelings of sheer happiness come through 
loud and clear.

The explanation of the outfit continued 
for a while after, bringing Haru Urara's 
brightest smile of the day—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Everyone did so, so much 'hard work' for 
me, you know!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing, and it makes you so happy, 
doesn't it?

Just as Haru Urara said, so many people 
helped make this outfit. If everyone's 
feelings are poured into it—
choice_data_list: I can feel power welling up inside me
I can feel power welling up inside me

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When I wear this, I feel like I can 
do way, waaaay more things than I can now!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
So, just like how everyone tries their 
hardest, I'm gonna do my very best in 
training too!

Haru Urara's radiant smile, bright enough 
to blow away the cold, shone under the 
blue sky.

Just as Haru Urara said, so many people 
helped make this outfit. If everyone's 
feelings are poured into it—
choice_data_list:
It seems like everyone is always there for 
you.

It looks like everyone is always there for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: ! I see... You're right!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I only asked for 'something cute,' but 
this is so much more than that!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even when I'm running in a race, everyone 
is right there with me...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Then I won't be lonely at all!

Gently stroking the outfit with care, Haru 
Urara broke into a warm smile.
